title: how to customize dashboard themes
text:
Customizing your dashboard with themes allows you to personalize its appearance and enhance its visual appeal. Follow these simple steps to apply a theme or create your own.

TABLE OF CONTENTS
 [#Step-1%3A-Open-Your-Dashboard%3A] Step 1: Open Your Dashboard:
 [#Step-2%3A-Enter-Edit-Mode%3A] Step 2: Enter Edit Mode:
 [#Step-3%3A-Access-the-Themes-Section%3A] Step 3: Access the Themes Section:
 [#Step-4%3A-Choose-or-Create-a-Theme%3A] Step 4: Choose or Create a Theme:
 [#Step-5%3A-Save-Your-Changes%3A] Step 5: Save Your Changes:
 [#Step-6%3A-Widget-Themes(Optional)%3A] Step 6: Widget Themes(Optional):

Step 1: Open Your Dashboard:

Navigate to the dashboard you want to customize.
 [image:  https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155037058284/original/lUE1D8ywhjdjCvu9KOKjAe70Y_X09KIwaQ.png?1732288324] 

Step 2: Enter Edit Mode:

Click on the Pencil icon in the top-right corner of the dashboard.
 [image:  https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155037058332/original/PS7soQNVsTny_XFkPuWtWVlhuiZPEKKc8A.png?1732288358] 

After entering edit mode, select Add Widget to access customization options.
 [image:  https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155037058383/original/WopClLrIBLHZDOy3sHRtvCYNKafXnXgeYg.png?1732288391] 

Step 3: Access the Themes Section:

In the sidebar that appears, switch to the Themes tab.
 [image:  https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155037058467/original/ll-mX_barsSCyl73dX7U-pk0ayVqb_xOGA.png?1732288445] 

Step 4: Choose or Create a Theme:

You can either:

Select a predefined theme from the available options, or

Create your own custom theme by configuring each dashboard element (such as background color, text color, widget styles, etc.).
 [image:  https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155037058605/original/5Ckf-mJqYTvMWMJEj3TdkMbqs6-CRVphjw.png?1732288513] 

Step 5: Save Your Changes:

Once you've chosen or created your theme, click Save to apply the changes to your dashboard.
 [image:  https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155037058637/original/Q6Ncj7U1SrvueV2p1HS7rd5KG5R5ojmcFA.png?1732288530] 

Step 6: Widget Themes(Optional):

Specific widgets can be configured with themes as well, to do this edit a widget and on the side bar switch to the the theme section.
